description: “It is an honor to have the endorsement of the Civil Service Employees Association (CSEA). I’ve always had great respect and appreciation for hardworking CSEA members who are on the front lines every day, delivering vital programs and services to New Yorkers. You are truly the heart and soul of public service in NYS – thank you for all you do!”

title: CSEA Endorses Senator Borrello
